name: meto
description: Guards and views for meto projects: overlap and domain guards, one report per agent, board pane, swarm band, slice IDs, handoff reminder

idPrefix.title: Slice ID prefix
idPrefix.description: Prefix /meto-slice uses for new IDs: slice gives slice-173, Lom_Slice gives Lom_Slice-0043. Set your own so two people never take the same ID.

swarmBand.title: Swarm row above the prompt
swarmBand.description: Show each epic's status above the prompt. Off by default; /meto-board always shows it.
